title: Train a merge vocabulary from corpus evidence
description: Change the training slice and merge budget. Watch frequent local pairs become reusable tokens while rare forms remain compositional.

corpora.label: Related word forms
corpora.detail: Repeated stems reward reusable subword pieces.
corpora.decisionPrompt: A compact merge budget should discover low and its common continuations without memorizing every complete word.

corpora.label: Support requests
corpora.detail: A narrow business domain promotes high-frequency operational terms.
corpora.decisionPrompt: Domain terms compress well, but a vocabulary trained only here may fragment unrelated language.

corpora.label: Code identifiers
corpora.detail: Punctuation and naming conventions change which pairs dominate.
corpora.decisionPrompt: Code-aware merges can shorten identifiers, but the source mix must include the languages and naming styles served later.
